title: v0.34.2-rc2: mlxrunner: Release freed KV buffers during speculative decode
description: The decode loop releases MLX's pool of freed buffers every 256 generated tokens, which is also how often the KV cache grows and drops its previous, smaller buffers. The check fires only when the token count lands exactly on a multiple of 256. Speculative decoding emits several tokens per round, so most rounds step over the boundary and the pool is never released.
